prompt: The upstream-sync workflow just opened PR #99 on zjean/server and it's CONFLICTING. Get it merged.

assertions.text: Identifies that `upstream-main` is workflow-writable only and cannot be pushed to directly
assertions.rationale: Core insight that motivates the whole procedure

assertions.text: Closes the CONFLICTING PR (#99) and opens a replacement, rather than trying to fix in place
assertions.rationale: In-place fix is impossible and the model shouldn't attempt it

assertions.text: Cuts a resolution branch off `main` (e.g. `sync/upstream-YYYY-MM-DD`) and merges `origin/upstream-main` into it with `--no-ff`
assertions.rationale: The specific branching/merge pattern that preserves upstream lineage

assertions.text: Calls out i18n JSON (`frontend/src/i18n/*.json`) as the common/typical conflict pattern
assertions.rationale: Practical guidance grounded in how syncs actually conflict on this repo

assertions.text: Uses `--repo zjean/server` on `gh pr create` for the replacement PR
Explicitly reminds the user to use **merge commit** (not squash) when merging the replacement PR
assertions.rationale: GitHub remembers last-used strategy; this is the most common silent failure
